title: Silver Zoom Card: Tracking and Maximizing Your Fuel Savings
summary: This document explains how to use the Silver Zoom Card to track and maximize fuel savings: review transaction details for a 10.0% discount and 3.0% rewards on eligible transportation/logistics categories, filter by merchant category and fuel tags, and export data for route/vehicle analysis. It also covers reconciling receipts to statement line items and flagging transactions missing the expected reduction.
faqs: How can I identify transactions where my Silver Zoom Card applied the 10.0% fuel discount?

How can I filter my statement to isolate qualifying fuel activity (merchant category and fuel tags)?
How do I estimate discounted fuel savings using the document’s 10.0% calculation?
